description: This file is a Spring MVC controller class named 'TaxRatesController' in a Java-based e-commerce application. It manages tax rate CRUD operations, listing, and pagination within the admin interface, and interacts with various services and models related to tax rates, tax classes, countries, zones, and merchants.

classes.name: TaxRatesController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling admin operations related to tax rates, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and pagination of tax rates.

methods.name: displayTaxRates
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of tax rates for the store, setting up the model with necessary data.

methods.name: pageTaxRates
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated tax rate data in JSON format for the frontend DataTables or similar component.

methods.name: saveTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new tax rate after validation.

methods.name: updateTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing tax rate after validation.

methods.name: removeTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a tax rate, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load a tax rate for editing based on its ID.

methods.name: validateTaxRate
methods.description: Validates the TaxRate object during save/update operations, checking required fields and business rules.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the current menu context for the admin UI.
